validation.result: PASS (Davies-Harte embedding exact and nonnegative for all H,n used; sample autocov, Var(sum)=n^2H and full covariance match theory)

processes.G1: unit fGn, Davies-Harte minimal circulant embedding m=2(n-1), real part, H in {0.5,0.6,0.7,0.75,0.8,0.9}; X,Y independent, H_X=H_Y=H
processes.G2: X=2*Phi(xi)-1, Phi via math.erf, same H grid
processes.R1: Euler fOU x_t=(1-lam)x_{t-1}+fGn_t(H=0.1), x_0=0, burn-in ceil(10/lam), lam in {0.01,0.1}; series = x (log sigma); X,Y independent

null: X and Y from independent generators

K-ind.HSIC: Gaussian kernels exp(-d^2/(2 s^2)), s = median of off-diagonal pairwise |x_i-x_j| per series (median of positive distances if that is 0), lag 0; statistic n*HSIC_V = (1/n) sum_ij Kc_ij Lc_ij with double-centred Grams
K-ind.dCov: lag 0; statistic n*dCov^2_V = (1/n) sum_ij A_ij B_ij with double-centred |x_i-x_j| matrices
K-ind.wild_bootstrap: 500 draws; Rademacher block-Markov multipliers: W_1=+-1, sign flip w.p. (1-exp(-1/l_n))/2 so Corr(W_s,W_t)=exp(-|s-t|/l_n); l_n=floor(n^0.5) [design silent on l_n: worker choice]; empirically centred W (CSG 2014 eq. 3); bootstrap stat (1/n) sum W_i W_j M_ij; p=(1+#{B>=T})/(1+500); reject p<=0.05; same multipliers for HSIC and dCov within a replication
K-ind.shift_test: HSIC only; all circular shifts c in [floor(0.1n), n-floor(0.1n)] of Y (worker choice, design silent on shift range); p=(1+#{S(c)>=S(0)})/(1+#shifts); reject p<=0.05
K-ind.subsampling: Betken-Dehling sampling-window: l=floor(n^0.5), d_n=floor(0.1n), m=n-l-d_n windows (X block at k, Y block at k+d_n), T_l = l * V-statistic; HSIC windows use the full-sample bandwidths (worker choice); reject if T_n > numpy quantile(T_l, 0.95)

L-ind.T_note: design fixes T in {500,2000,8000} for Linear; coordinator message listed n in {500..4000} for all my families; design governs
L-ind.HAC_NW: Bartlett weights 1-j/S for j<S; Andrews (1991) AR(1) plug-in S=1.1447*(alpha1*T)^(1/3), alpha1=4 rho^2/((1-rho)^2(1+rho)^2), S capped at T-1; two-sided N(0,1) critical 1.959964
L-ind.EWC: nu=floor(0.4*T^(2/3)) cosine projections (LLSW 2018 rule); two-sided t_nu 0.975 critical (computed by numerical integration)

power_check: G2 at H=0.7, Betken-Dehling 'linear' r=0.25 (latent eta = r*xi + sqrt(1-r^2)*eta'), all K-ind tests at all n and L-ind at all T; 1000 reps per power cell

seeds.rule: SeedSequence(entropy=master, spawn_key=(cell_idx, rep)) per replication; cell_idx = index in run_sim.cell_list()

replications_rule: timing pilot 20 reps per cell (not evidence). Main: 2000 reps per cell if projected total CPU for kernel-linear (K-ind + L-ind + power) <= 48 CPU-hours; else 1000 reps for K-ind cells at n=4000 (design fallback), all other size cells 2000; if still > 48, stop and ask coordinator
cpu_accounting: sum of per-replication process CPU seconds (cpu_s column); <=8 worker processes, BLAS single-threaded

analysis.size: rejection rate at 5%; excess = size - 0.05; Wilson 95% MC interval per cell; every cell reported incl. errors
analysis.x_variable: H_X+H_Y over G1-G4 cells (22 points); R1 reported descriptively, not in fits
analysis.knot: y = a + b x + c (x-k)_+ fitted to excess at largest n; k by profile least squares on grid [1.10,1.70] step 0.005; 95% percentile CI from 2000 bootstrap resamples of cells (seed 20261015003)
analysis.P1: per test: supported iff every cell with H_X+H_Y<1.5 has excess at n_max <= 2pp (point estimate) AND every cell with H_X+H_Y>1.5 grows with n; cells with sum = 1.5 are boundary, reported only
analysis.follows_line: knot CI contains 1.5 and growth with n only for sum > 1.5
analysis.KC1: triggered iff every G1-G3 cell (H<=0.9) at n=4000 has size in [3.5%,6.5%] for BOTH wild-bootstrap tests (HSIC and dCov)
analysis.KC2: headline on HSIC wild bootstrap (others reported): triggered iff knot CI excludes 1.5, OR (mean G1-G3 excess at H=0.6 at n_max > 5pp AND bootstrap 95% CI of slope change c contains 0)
